entries.name: Hospital Veterinario Central (HVC)
entries.address: Calle 13 (Av. José M. Fadul) 29, El Embrujo I
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 9:00-18:00, Sat 9:00-14:00, closed Sundays and holidays. 24/7 phone emergency line for registered patients only.
entries.note: Second phone +1 809 806 0991; WhatsApp appointments +1 829 868 2588. Clinic itself not open 24 h.

duty_i18n.es: Lun–vie 9:00–18:00 h, sáb 9:00–14:00 h, dom y festivos cerrado. Línea telefónica de urgencias las 24 horas, todos los días, solo para pacientes registrados.
duty_i18n.it: Lun–ven 9:00–18:00, sab 9:00–14:00, chiuso la domenica e nei festivi. Linea telefonica di emergenza 24 ore su 24, 7 giorni su 7, solo per pazienti registrati.
duty_i18n.pt: Segunda a sexta 9h00–18h00, sábado 9h00–14h00, encerrado aos domingos e feriados. Linha de urgência telefónica 24 h/24, 7 dias por semana, apenas para pacientes registados.
duty_i18n.nl: ma–vr 9.00–18.00 uur, za 9.00–14.00 uur, gesloten op zondagen en feestdagen. 24/7 telefonische spoedlijn alleen voor geregistreerde patiënten.
duty_i18n.pl: Pon.–pt. 9:00–18:00, sob. 9:00–14:00, niedz. i święta nieczynne. Całodobowa telefoniczna linia alarmowa tylko dla zarejestrowanych pacjentów.
duty_i18n.cs: Po–Pá 9:00–18:00, so 9:00–14:00, v neděli a o svátcích zavřeno. Nonstop telefonická pohotovostní linka pouze pro registrované pacienty.
duty_i18n.sv: mån–fre 9.00–18.00, lör 9.00–14.00, stängt söndagar och helgdagar. Jourtelefon dygnet runt, årets alla dagar, endast för registrerade patienter.
duty_i18n.da: man–fre 9.00–18.00, lør 9.00–14.00, lukket søn og helligdage. Akuttelefon døgnet rundt kun for registrerede patienter.
duty_i18n.fi: ma–pe klo 9.00–18.00, la klo 9.00–14.00, suljettu sunnuntaisin ja pyhäpäivinä. 24/7 päivystyspuhelin vain rekisteröidyille potilaille.
duty_i18n.nb: man–fre 9.00–18.00, lør 9.00–14.00, stengt søndager og helligdager. Vakttelefon hele døgnet, alle dager, kun for registrerte pasienter.
duty_i18n.sl: Pon–pet 9–18, sob 9–14, ob nedeljah in praznikih zaprto. Nujna telefonska linija 24/7 samo za registrirane paciente.

notes: Thin run: no official body page (CMVD, Ministerio de Agricultura, university hospitals) yielded a usable clinic list; no animal poison line or duty rota found (none known to exist). Blocked by the fetch tool (URL not allowed / robots / client error), not opened: hospitalveterinariocentral.com (robots), veterinariadrdelacruz.com (Puerto Plata/Sosua), eldinero.com.do, facebook (Vet Mart 24h, VetPlaza 24hrs), instagram. Not opened for provenance reasons (leads only from the dd.com.do listing): servican.com.do, hospitalveterinarioreal.com, faunatikapetshop.com (Punta Cana, emergency services), clinicaveterinariaamerica.com, vetmord.com, pilisvet.com, zoolandiard.com (Santiago), unphu.edu.do/clinica-veterinaria/, animed.do, veterinariaflaquer (La Romana), petcare.com.do, petland.com.do. Leads from aggregators only (not used as entries): Vet Mart Clinica Veterinaria 24 horas, Santo Domingo Este, +1 809 788 0361 (claims 24 h); Pets Valley (Naco, emergency 809 398 0005); Open Doors Veterinary Wellness (Bavaro). Not covered: Puerto Plata/Sosua, La Romana, Samana. Removed Vet Arroyo Hondo (vetarroyohondo.com.do): page says "Emergencia abierta las 24 horas" but shows no clinic name, address or phone, so the entry could not be confirmed or contacted.
